title: Uniform terminal certificates for iPRA
new_contribution: A uniform terminal-packet protocol, with a single checked-goal membership test for retained hypotheses and computation leaves; its retraction-based relative correctness proof and complete implementations.
interpretation_status: Inherited whole-domain actual-equality bi-interpretation, transferred through the written canonical public theorem equivalence of the new certificate protocol.
mathematical_proof_status: Written universal relative proof; upstream theorem dependencies explicitly cited and supplied as sources.
resource_convention: Ideal finite execution without fixed memory or recursion-depth limits; a physical resource exception rejects.
